title: Agora Workbench: Data Lake Authorization Scope Enforcement & Bounded v2 Streaming Object Transfer
summary: PolicyEnforcedCatalogProvider protects multi-source data catalogs by requiring matching per-artifact enforcers, constraining search/list requests prior to pagination, rejecting continuation cursors whenever effective authorized source_ids shift, and collapsing unauthorized get/resolve calls to not-found errors. Alongside catalog auth, object_transfer bounds cross-kernel object streaming at 256 MB using v2 64 KB metadata headers, 4-byte aligned incremental base64 decoding, strict correlation IDs, and duplicate JSON key rejection.

references.description: PolicyEnforcedCatalogProvider mode validation and pre-pagination _constrain_request execution
Non-enumerable not-found masking and cursor invalidation on effective source_ids mismatch
256 MB transfer limit, STREAMING_TRANSFER_VERSION='2', 64 KB header cap, and _IncrementalBase64Decoder
Correlation ID regex enforcement, _reject_duplicate_streaming_keys, and receive_legacy_streaming_transfer
